biotools.summary: synfit fits 4- and 5-parameter Hill curves to dose-response data and reports IC50/EC50 with 95% confidence intervals. For two-drug combination matrices it fits both drugs jointly and reports Bliss independence, Loewe additivity, HSA and ZIP synergy side by side. Free, runs in the browser, no install. Single-drug fits use explicit noise models (lognormal, heteroscedastic Gaussian) and give 95% confidence intervals on every parameter; inverse prediction returns a concentration with its confidence interval from a given response. Plots can be exported as PNG/SVG, outliers excluded, and read-only share links created. The numerical core is the open-source Python package synfit (MIT).
